CREATE TABLE role_runtime_session (
  role_runtime_session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  case_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  role_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  catalog_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runtime_catalog_version(catalog_version_id),
  primary_activity_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8,
  selected_primary_activity_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  secondary_activity_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_estimated_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_elapsed_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft','active','in_progress','ready_with_flags','completed','blocked','archived')),
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE source_node_ref (
  source_node_ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  catalog_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runtime_catalog_version(catalog_version_id),
  source_block TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_question_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_document_ref TEXT,
  node_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
);

CREATE TABLE runtime_interaction_mapping (
  mapping_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  runtime_interaction_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runtime_interaction_def(runtime_interaction_id),
  source_node_ref_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_node_ref(source_node_ref_id),
  mapped_variable TEXT,
  mapping_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mapping_role IN ('primary','secondary','critical_route','clarification','derivation')),
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE evidence_item (
  evidence_item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_runtime_run(run_id),
  interaction_instance_id TEXT REFERENCES runtime_interaction_instance(interaction_instance_id),
  subfield_response_id TEXT REFERENCES runtime_subfield_response(subfield_response_id),
  literal_value TEXT,
  epistemic_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  provenance_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  confidence NUMERIC,
  response_revision_number

function recompute_after_response_revision(run_id, response_id):
  mark_superseded_response(response_id)
  affected = find_dependent_records(response_id)
  mark_as_stale(affected.variables, affected.gaps, affected.candidates, affected.payloads)
  recompute_canonical_variables(run_id, affected.scope)
  recompute_critical_routes(run_id)
  recompute_branching_decisions(run_id)
  recompute_readiness(run_id)
  if affected.payloads:
      supersede_parallel_payloads(run_id)
  append_runtime_audit_trail(run_id, "recompute_after_revision")
